_about: The repo's statement of what is on the OSF (account kguxq, Will Conner). Edited by hand, in the same commit as the OSF write it records; analysis/scripts/osf_reconcile.py checks it both ways and never writes it. Times are UTC as the OSF reports them; Alberta time is UTC-6 (MDT) or UTC-7 (MST) before 2026-11-01, and UTC-6 (Alberta Time, no clock changes) from 2026-11-01; notes written before 2026-11-07 that say MST on or after 2026-11-01 are UTC-7. First pinned 2026-11-01 from a read-only pass, every entry reviewed against the OSF.
